issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the UML in problem_statement.md declares the method as returning int, while the template's inline comment indicates the return type should be double ("Return type: double for precise calculation") and the solution implements public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). This mismatch can confuse students: they may follow the UML and implement an int return type (or expect tests to accept int), which will not match the intended double-based implementation and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML entry in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double and add a short note in the description that the method should return a double for precise calculation. Ensure the template comments and any tests expect a double. Alternatively (less preferred), change the template comment and solution implementation to return int if integer division is intended.
